notes: Algorithm measured on the AE refs (alpha step response at the layer edges, then whole-image least-squares fits of candidate models): per axis, THREE iterated box blurs of the PREMULTIPLIED colour, horizontal first then vertical; each box has a fractional radius rho = 0.369 * Blurriness px (weight 1 for |x| <= floor(rho), frac(rho) at floor(rho)+1, total width 2 rho + 1; fitted coefficient 0.369 +- 0.0002, no offset, same at Blurriness 10 and 25). Gaussian, 2/4/5-box and integer-radius 3-box models fit clearly worse. With Repeat Edge Pixels OFF, AE blurs on an unbounded transparent plane: the three box passes are not cropped to the layer (cropping each box costs up to 4 LSB near the canvas corner at Blurriness 25). AE rounds to 8 bits after every box (bit-level emulation: mean 0.006 / 0.017 %, max 1-2). The shader does 2 passes (pass 0 = horizontal, pass 1 = vertical) with the exact composite kernel b*b*b (built by walking its third difference, 16 impulses), so it rounds only once per axis (RGBA8 intermediate): <= 2 LSB from AE. Cost: 6 floor(rho) + 7 taps per pass, direct up to 300 taps (Blurriness <= ~132), exact bilinear pairs up to 600 taps (<= ~268), beyond that a coarse kernel sampled every G px (approximation: ~0.15 % mean difference from the exact kernel at Blurriness 400-1000; AE may also change algorithm at such sizes, unmeasured). Blur Dimensions 2 (Horizontal) / 3 (Vertical) skip the other pass (checked against the numpy model, not against AE refs). Repeat Edge Pixels ON (the AE default) = clamp-to-edge source, extended once before the blur (unverified vs AE: the visible refs all have it OFF; AE could instead clamp between its box passes, which would only differ within ~3 rho px of the layer edges). Wrapper notes for ae2rml: with Repeat Edge Pixels OFF AE grows the layer by the blur, so the node's pad should be >= 3 * (floor(0.369 * Blurriness) + 1) px when the content reaches the layer edges; with Repeat Edge Pixels ON keep pad = 0 (a transparent pad would be the 'edge' that gets repeated). Not reproduced: Compositing Options (AE 4: effect opacity / effect masks; effect opacity can be mapped to the node's amount). 16/32 bpc AE projects do not quantize between boxes (sub-LSB difference).
